Class MainMenuController

java.lang.Object
com.examplez.demo.controllers.MainMenuController
public class MainMenuController extends Object
FXML controller for the main game view (main-menu-view.fxml).

Manages the 6Ã—6 Sudoku board rendered as a grid of TextField nodes, handles user input validation in real time, and coordinates with SudokuGame to generate boards, dispense clues, and detect completion.

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Called automatically by the JavaFX FXML loader after all @FXML fields have been injected.

      Populates the blocks convenience array with references to the injected TextField nodes so that the rest of the controller can address cells by [row][col] index rather than by field name.

    • onButtonPlay

      protected void onButtonPlay()
      Handles the Play button click.

      Generates a new fully solved board via SudokuGame.fillFullBoard(), selects which cells to reveal using SudokuGame.chooseCluesToShow(), clears the UI grid, renders the initial clues, registers text-change listeners on every editable cell, and transitions the toolbar to in-game state (shows the Clue button, hides the Play button).

    • onButtonClue

      protected void onButtonClue()
      Handles the Clue button click.

      Requests the next hidden cell from SudokuGame.giveClue(TextField[][]) and reveals its correct value in the board. After revealing the clue, checks whether the newly placed value conflicts with any existing entry in the same row or column and highlights any offending cell in red.

      If the maximum number of clues has already been reached (SudokuGame.isPossibleGiveClue(boolean[][]) returns false), displays an informational message and takes no further action.
